methodology.cscv_pbo: AFML SS11.6-11.7 (p.157-167): Combinatorially Symmetric Cross-Validation. Rolling-start windows are split into S=16 contiguous blocks; every C(16,8) train/test split picks the in-sample best-net-profit scenario and checks its out-of-sample relative rank. PBO = fraction of splits where the IS winner underperformed the OOS median.
methodology.grouping: CSCV requires every candidate compared on identical observations, so PBO is computed separately within each (return_mode, universe, profile_role, linkage_method) group -- scenarios sharing the same underlying rolling-start windows.
methodology.not_a_gate: This lab is diagnostic only. It does not change Step 08's own scenario selection (robust_rank / fast_safe_rank). It reports whether that selection process is exposed to overfitting risk.
